content: FreshBooks (paid SMB accounting): invoicing with auto-added tracked time and expenses, tax calculation, customizable payment options; billing/payments with automated invoices+reminders; expense tracking with receipt scanning and bank imports; plus accounting, payroll, mileage, proposals/estimates, reporting, client management, team collaboration, mobile apps. Confirms the full accounting-suite direction that invoice tools converge toward; document-creation-only is the deliberate anti-accounting niche.
